phase: Phase 5: Release Hardening, Security Verification & End-to-End Readiness

findings.title: Account Suspension Ban Expiry Timestamp Validation Vulnerability (Fail-Open on Malformed Timestamps)
findings.evidence: In assertAdminSession(), ban timestamps from Supabase user records or app_metadata were parsed via new Date(bannedUntil). When encountering unparseable or malformed date strings, banExpiry.getTime() evaluated to NaN. The check banExpiry > new Date() evaluated to false, allowing suspended users with corrupted ban timestamps to bypass the administrative suspension gate.
findings.exploitability_impact: High. An administrative account placed into suspension with an invalid timestamp string could bypass authorization checks and perform administrative operations.
findings.before_behavior: Evaluated only if (banExpiry > new Date()). Ignored NaN timestamps, resulting in fail-open behavior.
findings.after_behavior: Explicitly verifies isNaN(banExpiry.getTime()). If invalid, fails closed immediately with ForbiddenError('User account ban timestamp is invalid; access denied fail-closed').
findings.remediation: Updated assertAdminSession() in src/lib/auth/session.ts to fail closed on malformed dates. Added unit test in tests/admin-service.test.mjs.
test_references: tests/admin-service.test.mjs: assertAdminSession: Rejects malformed ban timestamp fail closed
findings.residual_risk: None. All timestamps must parse cleanly to valid ISO dates in the past to permit session access.

findings.title: Missing Outer Edge Proxy Route Protection for Administrative URL Hierarchy
findings.evidence: Next.js 16 proxy (Edge middleware) only matched and protected /dashboard routes. Requests to /admin and sub-routes were not intercepted at the network edge, relying exclusively on downstream Server Component execution.
findings.exploitability_impact: High. Unauthenticated clients could fetch administrative route HTML shells and trigger server component renders before redirection, exposing route existence and wasting server resources.
findings.after_behavior: Edge proxy intercepts both /admin and /dashboard. Unauthenticated visitors are redirected immediately to /auth/signin?next=<encoded_path>.
findings.remediation: Updated src/proxy.ts matcher and session verification to protect /admin and all sub-routes.
test_references: tests/e2e-workflows.test.mjs: Workflow 1: Unauthenticated visitor rejected by auth guard and server actions
findings.residual_risk: None. Both edge proxy and inner server-side assertAdminSession() enforce authentication.

findings.title: PostgreSQL Row-by-Row Unique Index Collision on Atomic Sequence Swap
findings.evidence: PostgreSQL evaluates unique indexes (uk_occurrence_paper_seq on paper_question_occurrences(paper_id, sequence_number)) row-by-row during statements. Single-statement CASE updates updating occurrence A to occurrence B's sequence number fail with 23505 unique constraint violation because occurrence B still occupies that sequence number at index evaluation time.
findings.exploitability_impact: High. Admin users could not reorder questions in the sequence editor without throwing database constraint errors.
findings.before_behavior: Single UPDATE statement with CASE expression threw duplicate key value violates unique constraint 'uk_occurrence_paper_seq'.
findings.after_behavior: Implemented 3-step atomic sequence swap: Step 1 sets occurrence A sequence to negative value (-occB.sequence_number); Step 2 sets occurrence B to occurrence A's sequence; Step 3 sets occurrence A to occurrence B's sequence. Row counts verified on each step, failing closed on concurrent modification.
findings.remediation: Refactored swapQuestionSequence() in src/lib/admin/service.ts to use 3-step sequence swap. Tested in unit and real PostgreSQL E2E suite.
test_references: tests/admin-workflows.test.mjs: swapQuestionSequence: Successfully swaps sequence numbers atomically on DRAFT paper
tests/e2e-workflows.test.mjs: Workflow 4: Admin successfully reorders adjacent questions in DRAFT paper
findings.residual_risk: None. The 3-step swap guarantees zero transient uniqueness collisions while enforcing optimistic concurrency.

findings.title: Adjacency Constraint Omission in Question Reordering Service
findings.evidence: The service allowed swapping any two arbitrary question occurrences. If an admin swapped non-adjacent questions (e.g. sequence 1 and 5), the internal sequence numbers became disjoint, creating gaps that fail publication Gate 5 (MCQJ-ERR-5008).
findings.exploitability_impact: Medium. Administrative UI could produce non-contiguous papers requiring manual database remediation before publication.
findings.after_behavior: Enforces Math.abs(occA.sequence_number - occB.sequence_number) === 1, failing closed with MCQJ_NONADJACENT_OCCURRENCES (422) if non-adjacent.
findings.remediation: Added adjacency verification to swapQuestionSequence() in src/lib/admin/service.ts.
test_references: tests/admin-workflows.test.mjs: swapQuestionSequence: Rejects non-adjacent sequence numbers
findings.residual_risk: None. Reordering is constrained to single adjacent swaps (Move Up / Move Down).

findings.title: Swallowed Cache Revalidation Errors and Incorrect Adjudication Route Path in Server Actions
findings.evidence: revalidateAdminPath() swallowed all errors in an empty catch block without logging. Furthermore, reevaluatePaperAttemptsAction attempted to revalidate /admin/papers/${paperId}/attempts, whereas the actual route is /admin/papers/${paperId}/adjudication.
findings.exploitability_impact: Medium. Admins performing answer-key adjudication could see stale adjudication UI due to incorrect path revalidation, and Next.js revalidation failures were invisible in server logs.
findings.before_behavior: Swallowed errors silently; targeted nonexistent /attempts route.
findings.after_behavior: Logs visible warning with console.warn on revalidation failure; targets actual /adjudication route.
findings.remediation: Updated src/app/admin/actions.ts with visible error logging and correct route paths.
test_references: tests/admin-workflows.test.mjs: reevaluatePaperAttemptsAction: Returns structured validation error on short reason
tests/e2e-workflows.test.mjs: Workflow 10: Server action failures return structured errors without mutating DB
findings.residual_risk: None. Cache paths reflect actual App Router directory structure.

findings.title: Off-by-One PostgreSQL Domain Error Code Mapping in Application Service
findings.evidence: In mapDatabaseDomainError(), error code MCQJ-ERR-5008 was mapped to 'Cannot publish paper with unverified question drafts' (which is actually MCQJ-ERR-5009 in PostgreSQL), and 5018 was mapped to orphaned comprehension passages instead of non-official answer key. This caused procedural database exceptions to return misleading user messages.
findings.exploitability_impact: Medium. Administrators received incorrect diagnostics when publication gates failed.
findings.before_behavior: MCQJ-ERR-5008 mapped to unverified question representations instead of sequence non-contiguity.
findings.after_behavior: All error codes MCQJ-ERR-5001 through 5018 strictly aligned with PostgreSQL procedures and triggers.
findings.remediation: Refactored switch block in src/lib/admin/service.ts mapDatabaseDomainError() to match PostgreSQL migration definitions.
test_references: tests/e2e-workflows.test.mjs: Workflow 6: Publication rejected when sequence has gap (MCQJ-ERR-5008) and rolled back cleanly
findings.residual_risk: None. Procedural error codes and user diagnostics are 1:1 aligned.

findings.title: Release Preflight Validator & Disposable Test Database Guard Implementation
findings.evidence: Prior to Phase 5, there was no automated gatekeeper preventing accidental test execution against staging/production databases, or verifying Prisma migration sequence continuity before staging deployment.
findings.exploitability_impact: Low (Preventative). Mitigates risk of accidental connection string misconfiguration during CI/CD runs.
findings.after_behavior: Added scripts/release-preflight.mjs which validates test DB isolation, verifies sequential migration history, checks Prisma schema syntax, and outputs human-executable staging runbook.
findings.remediation: Created scripts/release-preflight.mjs and added npm run preflight to package.json.
test_references: scripts/release-preflight.mjs: npm run preflight execution verified green
findings.residual_risk: None. Preflight must pass prior to release authorization.
